analysis.summary: Hindustan Zinc reported its highest-ever first quarter mined metal production of 268,000 tons and refined metal production of 260,000 tons for Q1 FY27. The company recorded an all-time high quarterly EBITDA of INR 8,074 crores and net profit of INR 5,469 crores, supported by a 16% YoY decline in zinc cost of production to USD 851 per ton. Management reiterated its full-year refined metal production guidance of 1.1 million tons and reported progress on strategic growth projects, including the Debari zinc smelter and tailings reprocessing plant. Additionally, the company declared an interim dividend of INR 11 per share and closed the quarter with a net cash position of INR 5,572 crores. Hindustan Zinc reported its highest-ever first-quarter mined metal production of 268 KT and refined metal production of 260 KT for Q1FY27.

guidance.claim: The company has reiterated its volume guidance of 1.1 million tons for the year.
guidance.quote: So roughly, we have given a guidance of 1.1 million tons for the year, right?

guidance.claim: Growth project capex guidance for the year is expected to be between USD 500 million and USD 600 million.
guidance.quote: So the guidance for the year is on the growth project is around USD500 million to USD600 million we are expecting.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 mined metal production of 1,150 KTPA plus or minus 10 KT.
guidance.quote: Looking into the year ahead, with a well-structured capex roadmap in place, we are confident in sustaining this strong performance in the year ahead with an expected mined metal production of 1,150 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT, and a refined metal production of 1,100 KTPA, plus or minus 10 KT, with an expected refined silver production of 680 tons, plus or minus 10 tons.

guidance.claim: For FY27, management guided zinc cost of production excluding royalty at $975 to $1,000 per ton.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we have guided zinc cost of production excluding royalty at $975 to $1,000 per ton, reflecting prevailing global uncertainties.

guidance.claim: Planned capital expenditure for FY27 is projected between $500 million and $600 million.
guidance.quote: Planned capital expenditure for FY27 is in the range of $500 million to $600 million towards announced growth projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturing activity remained in expansion territory, supported by resilient demand, government capex, and infrastructure investments.
demand_outlook.quote: Manufacturing activity remained in expansion territory during the quarter, supported by resilient domestic demand, sustained government capital expenditure and continued infrastructure investments.

demand_outlook.claim: Base metal market fundamentals were supported by constrained mine supply and steady demand across infrastructure, galvanization, and battery applications.
demand_outlook.quote: Market fundamentals remained broadly supportive, underpinned by constrained mine supply and steady demand from infrastructure, galvanization and battery applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand fundamentals stay supported by robust industrial demand from solar, electronics, and electrification applications.
demand_outlook.quote: Nevertheless, silver fundamentals remain supported by robust industrial demand from solar, electronics and electrification applications alongside continued investment interest.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic zinc demand is strengthening as domestic steel production capacity is expected to expand to 300 MTPA by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic zinc demand strengthens as domestic steel production capacity expands to 300 MTPA by 2030

demand_outlook.claim: The global energy transition is structurally accelerating the demand for zinc.
demand_outlook.quote: Global energy transition accelerates zinc demand structurally

demand_outlook.claim: India's GDP growth for FY 2027 is projected to remain resilient around 6.4% to 6.9%.
demand_outlook.quote: The country's GDP growth for FY 2027 is expected to remain resilient at around 6.4% to 6.9% supported by continued government capex, infrastructure push, and robust domestic consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Base metal markets remained relatively resilient despite a volatile global macroeconomic backdrop.
demand_outlook.quote: Against a volatile global macroeconomic backdrop, base metal markets have remained relatively resilient.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand is supported by industrial applications, particularly from solar and electronics.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver, however, continues to stand out, maintaining strong momentum supported by robust industrial demand, particularly from solar and electronics, alongside continued investor interest.

capex_expansion.claim: Mine development activities have commenced to match mining capacity for the 250 KTPA integrated zinc smelter at Debari.
capex_expansion.quote: For the 250 KTPA integrated zinc smelter at Debari, mine development activities have started for matching the mining capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction activities and site mobilization for infrastructure development have started for the tailings reprocessing plant.
capex_expansion.quote: For the tailings reprocessing plant, construction activities have started and site mobilization for the infrastructure development is completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track for completion by the second quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Our other 2 key projects, that is hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track to be completed by the second quarter of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The target completion for the 250 KTPA integrated refined metal capacity expansion is 2QFY29.
The company is setting up India's first zinc tailings reprocessing plant with an approved investment of ₹3,823 crore.
The target completion for the zinc tailings reprocessing plant is 4QFY28.
The 510 KTPA fertilizer plant at Chanderiya is expected to be completed by 2QFY27.
Site mobilization is complete and detailed engineering is largely finalized for the 250,000 tons per annum integrated zinc smelter at Debari.
capex_expansion.quote: On the growth projects front, we are making steady progress for the 250,000 tons per annum integrated zinc smelter at Debari. Site mobilization is complete and detailed engineering is largely finalized.

capex_expansion.claim: At Rampura Agucha, site work for the tailings reprocessing plant has commenced with engineering completed.
capex_expansion.quote: At Rampura Agucha, site work for the tailings reprocessing plant has commenced, with engineering completed.

capex_expansion.claim: Exploration for 2x growth plans is accelerating with partners onboarded at Zawar and Rajpura Dariba.
capex_expansion.quote: In parallel, we are accelerating exploration for our 2x growth plans with partners onboarded at Zawar and Rajpura Dariba.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure for FY26 was INR3,600 crores, including growth capex of INR2,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Total capex was INR3,600 crores for the full year and growth capex was INR2,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Zinc cost of production excluding royalty fell 16% year-on-year to USD 851 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: On the cost front, despite the volatile geopolitical environment, we achieved the lowest quarterly zinc cost of production, excluding royalty, since underground transition to USD851 per ton, reflecting a decline of 16% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Power and fuel costs increased sequentially due to lower materialization of linkage coal and higher imported coal costs.
margins_costs.quote: So the power and fuel cost during the quarter has dincreased majorly due to our materialization of linkage coal, which is slightly lower due to the various reasons, including the mine conditions from where we take coal.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin for the first quarter of FY27 was 59%.
On a full year basis, the company delivered a five-year low cost of production at $959 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: On a full year basis, we delivered a five-year low cost of production at $959 per ton, well below our guidance of $1,000 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 EBITDA margin stood at an industry-leading level of 57.0%.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at record INR7,747 crores, up 61.0% Y-o-Y and 27.0% quarter-on-quarter, with industry-leading EBITDA margin of 57.0%.

orders_capacity.claim: Silver production reached 149 tons during the quarter, contributing 46% to overall profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: We achieved 149 tons of silver production in line with the lead production and our silver portfolio continues to contribute 46% to overall profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company monetized 10,000 tons of lead concentrate equivalent to roughly 9 tons of silver and 6,000 tons of lead metal content.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we also monetized 10 kt of lead concentrate equivalent to approximate 9 tons of silver and 6,000 tons of lead metal content.

orders_capacity.claim: The company crossed 1.1 million tons of mined metal and sustained over 1 million tons of refined metal production for the fourth consecutive year.
orders_capacity.quote: This year, we set a new milestone by crossing 1.1 million tons of mined metal while sustaining over 1 million ton of refined metal production for the fourth consecutive year.

orders_capacity.claim: Ore resources and reserves reached record levels of 468.6 million tons with a mining life of over 25 years.
orders_capacity.quote: We also achieved record ore resources and reserves of 468.6 million tons with 25 years plus of mining life and recorded highest ever metal reserves of around 14 million tons and highest ever silver reserve of 10,900 tons since underground transition.

capital_allocation.claim: Hindustan Zinc achieved a record quarterly net profit of INR 5,469 crores, up 145% year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: Reflecting this strong operating performance, we delivered our record quarterly net profit of INR5,469 crores, up 145% year-on-year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash balance of INR 5,572 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended this quarter with a net cash position of INR5,572 crores, providing significant financial flexibility to pursue value-accretive growth opportunities while maintaining an attractive shareholder return profile.

capital_allocation.claim: Hindustan Zinc paid its first interim dividend of INR 11 per share during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Reflecting our confidence in the business and strong cash generation, during the quarter, the company paid its first interim dividend of INR11 per share, reaffirming our commitment to delivering sustainable shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to maintain its AAA credit rating.
The company closed the year with a net cash position of INR5,594 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strong cash generation enabled us to close the year with a net cash position of INR5,594 crores as of March '26, compared to a net debt position of INR1,169 crores at the close of the last year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a first interim dividend of INR11 per share for FY27, amounting to around INR4,300 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: And out of that, Board has approved the first interim dividend of INR11, which is around INR4,300 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cost reduction benefits were partially offset by higher input commodity prices, particularly energy prices driven by global geopolitical crises.
risks_headwinds.quote: The reduction was driven by better grade, higher metal production, increased renewable power consumption and better by-product realization, partly offset by higher input commodity prices, especially energy prices in line with the geopolitical crisis globally.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company incurred hedge losses of INR 200 crores during the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the hedge losses are to the tune of INR200 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted an unexpected man-machine interaction incident at the Zawar mines on January 25, 2026, resulting in a fatality.
risks_headwinds.quote: Before we begin, it is with deep sorrow that I share an unfortunate incident at our Zawar mines on 25th of January 2026, wherein we lost an employee of our business partner due to an unexpected man-machine interaction.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global macro environment continues to feature uneven growth and geopolitical volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global macro environment continues to be marked by uneven growth and geopolitical volatility.

management_commitments.claim: The hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are scheduled for completion by the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Our other 2 key projects, that is hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track to be completed by the second quarter of the year.

management_commitments.claim: The fertilizer plant construction is targeted to come in place by Q1 of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Fertilizer plant should come in place by quarter 1 of next financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to disseminating investigation learnings and strengthening safety protocols following safety incidents.
management_commitments.quote: Following a thorough investigation, we are committed to disseminating learnings across the organization while implementing corrective measures and strengthening safety protocols to prevent such tragedies in future.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of the Hot Acid Leaching process is expected in 2Q FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Given its complexity as a first-of-its-kind project in India, commissioning is now expected in 2Q FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The fertilizer project is on track for commissioning in early 2Q FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The fertilizer project is also on track for commissioning in early 2Q FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Renewable energy share is targeted to reach 70% round the clock by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: By FY28 we'll be 70% round the clock.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
